answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a scarce, verifiable stake by requiring every participant to lock a unique liquidity buffer, audited like timber marked at the wharf before trade. Each agent then posts a distinct pigment-tagged bond whose cryptographic provenance is checked against the anti-collusion auction registry, so duplicate identities. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
